    OUR APPROACH
    BUILT AROUND CLEANING BUSINESSES

    Business understanding.
    Technical delivery.

    WORKX IT is a software development partner for cleaning business owners and management teams in Australia. We focus on website development and build further digital solutions around each business’s needs.

    01

    Start with your business goals.

    Tell us whether you need a new website, an improved website or software to take more of your business online.

    02

    Design and develop your solution.

    We turn agreed requirements into a website or software solution, with design reviews, development and testing throughout the project.

    03

    Build an ongoing partnership.

    We plan hosting, maintenance and ongoing support around the agreed solution. Further development follows your business priorities.

    Can we start with a website?

    Yes. Website development is our main starting point. You can choose the website service on its own and discuss further software when your business needs it.

    Do we need to replace our existing tools?

    We start with what works. Integration options and any limitations are checked before a solution is agreed.

    What happens after launch?

    Hosting, maintenance and support responsibilities are defined as part of your project. We discuss future improvements as your requirements develop.

    Are the examples real client results?

    The interactive section shows possible website and software projects, not measured results. The Tangora showcase displays our actual website work. Your own project is planned and agreed with you.
